title: Physics Advisor Panel (HTML/JS)
description: Build the PRISM Physics Advisor panel that displays inside hyperMILL. Shows Kienzle cutting force predictions, stability lobe diagram (SLD) safe RPM zones, tool deflection warnings, and recommended speeds/feeds with P90 confidence bands. Includes an 'Apply to Operation' button that injects optimized parameters into the active hyperMILL cycle. Material-specific warnings for Ti thermal limits, Inconel work hardening, and hardened steel CBN routing.

physics: Kienzle kc1.1 constants per ISO group

forge_triple.action: hypermill_plugin:get_physics_advisory — BUILT (returns force + SLD + deflection for current op)
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-physics-advisor — BUILT (full physics advisory for active hyperMILL operation)

sessions.title: Physics Engine Integration + Panel UI
sessions.intent: Wire the physics engines (Kienzle force, SLD chatter, deflection) to a plugin-facing action and build the HTML/JS panel that visualizes force predictions, stability lobes, and deflection warnings with confidence bands.

units.title: Physics Advisory Action (Force + SLD + Deflection)
units.description: Create the hypermill_plugin:get_physics_advisory action that takes current operation context (material, tool, machine, cutting params) and returns Kienzle cutting force, ChatterStabilityLobe safe RPM zones, ToolDeflection predictions, and SpeedFeedOrchestrator recommended S/F with P90 confidence band. Wire through SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine's 8 resolvers.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Action returns Kienzle Fc with ±5% confidence interval for ISO P/M/K/N/S/H groups
SLD output includes safe RPM zones as array of {rpm_min, rpm_max, depth_limit} ranges
Deflection prediction returns value in mm with pass/fail against 0.05mm threshold

units.title: Physics Panel HTML/JS UI
units.description: Build the Physics Advisor HTML/JS panel with: force gauge visualization (Kienzle Fc as percentage of machine capacity), SLD chart (RPM vs depth-of-cut with safe/unsafe zones), deflection bar (green/yellow/red), recommended S/F card with confidence band. Use Canvas 2D for SLD chart rendering. Responsive layout that works docked or floating in hyperCAD-S.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: SLD chart renders with RPM on X-axis, axial depth on Y-axis, stable/unstable zones colored
Force gauge shows Fc as percentage of machine spindle torque capacity
Recommended S/F card displays spindle speed, feed rate, and P90 confidence range

units.title: Material-Specific Warnings System
units.description: Implement context-aware material warnings: Ti-6Al-4V thermal limit warnings (>800C), Inconel 718 work hardening alerts (feed below 0.05mm/tooth triggers hardening), hardened steel (>55 HRC) CBN routing recommendations, stainless steel BUE warnings at low speed. Wire to MaterialRegistry for ISO group and machinability class lookup.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Ti-6Al-4V operations show thermal warning when predicted temp exceeds 800C
Inconel 718 shows work hardening alert when fz < 0.05 mm/tooth
Hardened steel >55 HRC triggers CBN/PCBN tool routing recommendation

sessions.exit_gate: Physics advisory returns valid force+SLD+deflection + panel renders all visualizations | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Apply-to-Operation + Integration Testing
knowledge: AC Python API for parameter injection
sessions.intent: Build the Apply to Operation button that injects optimized S/F parameters into the active hyperMILL cycle, and write integration tests for the full physics advisory pipeline.

units.title: Apply-to-Operation Parameter Injection
units.description: Build the 'Apply to Operation' button handler that takes SpeedFeedOrchestrator recommendations and injects them into the active hyperMILL cycle via AC Python API. Map PRISM output (spindle_speed, feed_rate, depth_of_cut, stepover) to hyperMILL cycle parameter names. Add undo support (save original params before injection). Add confirmation dialog showing before/after comparison.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Apply button injects S/F/ap/ae into active hyperMILL cycle via AC API
Undo restores original parameters with single click
Before/after comparison dialog shows delta for each parameter

units.title: Physics Advisor Integration Tests
units.description: Write integration tests covering the full physics advisory pipeline: material lookup → force calculation → SLD generation → deflection check → S/F recommendation → parameter injection. Test with 5 representative materials (Ti-6Al-4V, Inconel 718, 4140 steel, 6061-T6 aluminum, hardened D2). Verify physics output against reference values from manufacturer datasheets.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: 5 material test cases pass with force predictions within 10% of reference
SLD safe zones validated against analytical Altintas model for simple cases
Parameter injection round-trip test (inject → read back → compare) passes

sessions.exit_gate: Apply button injects params + 5 material test cases pass + SLD validated | omega_floor >= 0.90
